headline: Unity has announced Spark, an AI tool that lets people with no game-making experience build and share games in a browser.
score_reason: Pool 2 kept: read in full; an official product announcement, with the critique marked as opinion.
importance_line: It matters most to people who want to make games without training and to working game developers, and the sharp verdict on it is Kotaku's opinion of Unity's launch trailer.
summary: Kotaku reports that Unity has announced Spark, a browser tool that lets people with no game-making experience make and share games, though it is still listed as coming soon. Kotaku criticises Unity's launch trailer, in which a user types six words to build a generic shooter from artist-made assets, and notes that Unity's own post says asking AI to copy an existing game does not make someone a great game maker.
